children.name: Postgres
children.query:
SELECT
    current_database() AS database,
    current_user AS user_name,
    current_setting('server_version') AS version,
    current_setting('data_directory') AS data_directory,
    current_setting('wal_level') AS wal_level,
    current_setting('archive_mode') AS archive_mode,
    current_setting('max_wal_size') AS max_wal_size,
    current_setting('checkpoint_timeout') AS checkpoint_timeout;

children.name: Postgres files
children.query:
SELECT
    name,
    setting
FROM pg_settings
WHERE name IN (
    'config_file',
    'hba_file',
    'ident_file',
    'data_directory'
);

children.name: Extensions
children.query:
SELECT e.extname AS "Name", e.extversion AS "Version", n.nspname AS "Schema", c.description AS "Description" 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension e 
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = e.extnamespace 
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_description c ON c.objoid = e.oid AND c.classoid = 'pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass 
ORDER BY 1;

children.name: Databases
children.query:
SELECT
    d.datname AS database_name,
    pg_encoding_to_char(d.encoding) AS encoding,
    r.rolname AS owner,
    d.datcollate AS lc_collate,
    d.datctype AS lc_ctype,
    COALESCE(ts.spcname, 'pg_default') AS tablespace,
    d.datistemplate AS is_template,
    d.datallowconn AS allow_connections,
    d.datconnlimit AS connection_limit,
    pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(d.datname)) AS size,
    d.datfrozenxid,
    age(d.datfrozenxid) AS xid_age
FROM pg_database d
JOIN pg_roles r
    ON d.datdba = r.oid
LEFT JOIN pg_tablespace ts
    ON d.dattablespace = ts.oid    
WHERE d.datname NOT IN ('postgres', 'template0', 'template1')
ORDER BY d.datname;

children.name: Tablespaces
children.query:
SELECT
    spcname AS tablespace_name,
    pg_get_userbyid(spcowner) AS owner,
    pg_size_pretty(pg_tablespace_size(oid)) AS size,
    pg_tablespace_location(oid) AS location,
    spcoptions AS options,
    pg_tablespace_size(oid)
FROM pg_tablespace
ORDER BY spcname;

children.name: Users
children.query:
SELECT
    rolname AS role_name,
    CASE WHEN rolsuper THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS superuser,
    CASE WHEN rolcanlogin THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS login,
    CASE WHEN rolcreatedb THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS createdb,
    CASE WHEN rolcreaterole THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS createrole,
    CASE WHEN rolreplication THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS replication,
    rolconnlimit
FROM pg_roles
ORDER BY login desc, rolname;

children.name: Tables
children.query:
SELECT
    n.nspname AS schema_name,
    c.relname AS table_name,
    usr.rolname owner,
    COALESCE(ts.spcname, 'database_default') AS tablespace,
    pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS table_size,
    pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(c.oid)) AS indexes_size,
    pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size,
    relpages pages,
    reltuples tuples
FROM pg_class c
JOIN pg_namespace n
    ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN pg_tablespace ts
    ON ts.oid = c.reltablespace
inner join pg_authid usr
    on (usr.oid = c.relowner)
WHERE c.relkind = 'r'
  AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema')
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC;

children.name: Parameters changed
children.query:
SELECT
    name,
    setting || COALESCE(unit, '') AS current_value,
    boot_val || COALESCE(unit, '') AS default_value,
    source,
    sourcefile,
    pending_restart
FROM pg_settings
WHERE setting <> boot_val
ORDER BY name;

children.name: Parameters set
children.query:
SELECT
    name,
    setting,
    sourcefile,
    sourceline
FROM pg_settings
WHERE sourcefile IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sourcefile, sourceline;

children.name: wal settings
children.query:
SELECT
    name,
    setting,
    unit
FROM pg_settings
WHERE name IN (
    'wal_level',
    'max_wal_size',
    'min_wal_size',
    'checkpoint_timeout',
    'checkpoint_completion_target',
    'wal_buffers',
    'archive_mode',
    'archive_command',
    'max_wal_senders',
    'max_replication_slots'
)
ORDER BY name;

children.name: active sessions
children.query:
SELECT pid, age(clock_timestamp(), query_start), usename, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE query != '<IDLE>' AND query NOT ILIKE '%pg_stat_activity%'
ORDER BY query_start DESC;

children.name: blocking locks
children.query:
SELECT
  blocked.pid AS blocked_pid,
  blocked.usename AS blocked_user,
  blocked.query AS blocked_query,
  blocking.pid AS blocking_pid,
  blocking.usename AS blocking_user,
  blocking.query AS blocking_query
FROM pg_stat_activity blocked
JOIN pg_stat_activity blocking
  ON blocking.pid = ANY(pg_blocking_pids(blocked.pid))
WHERE blocked.wait_event_type = 'Lock';

children.name: cache hit ratio
cache indexes
children.query:
SELECT sum(idx_blks_read) as idx_read, sum(idx_blks_hit)  as idx_hit, (sum(idx_blks_hit) - sum(idx_blks_read)) / sum(idx_blks_hit) as ratio
FROM pg_statio_user_indexes;

children.name: table vacuum
children.query:
SELECT
    schemaname schema,
    relname AS table_name,
    n_live_tup AS estimated_rows,
    pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size,
    last_vacuum,
    last_autovacuum,
    last_analyze,
    last_autoanalyze
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
ORDER BY schemaname, relname;

children.name: checkpoint status
children.query:
SELECT
    checkpoints_timed,
    checkpoints_req,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * checkpoints_req /
        NULLIF(checkpoints_timed + checkpoints_req, 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_requested_checkpoints,
    pg_size_pretty(
        buffers_checkpoint * current_setting('block_size')::bigint
    ) AS checkpoint_writes,
    pg_size_pretty(
        buffers_clean * current_setting('block_size')::bigint
    ) AS bgwriter_writes,
    pg_size_pretty(
        buffers_backend * current_setting('block_size')::bigint
    ) AS backend_writes,
    ROUND(checkpoint_write_time / 1000.0) AS checkpoint_write_sec,
    ROUND(checkpoint_sync_time / 1000.0) AS checkpoint_sync_sec,
    stats_reset
FROM pg_stat_bgwriter;

children.name: frequency
children.query:
SELECT
    checkpoints_timed,
    checkpoints_req,
    ROUND(
        checkpoints_req::numeric /
        NULLIF(checkpoints_timed, 0),
        2
    ) AS req_vs_timed_ratio
FROM pg_stat_bgwriter;
children.comment:
if checkpoints_req >> checkpoints_timed means:

max_wal_size too small
or 
high writing throughput

children.name: avg time
children.comment: Valori di avg_sync_ms elevati possono indicare storage lento o checkpoint troppo aggressivi

children.name: Writing %
children.query:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * buffers_backend /
        NULLIF(
            buffers_backend +
            buffers_checkpoint +
            buffers_clean,
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS backend_write_pct
FROM pg_stat_bgwriter;

children.name: pg_stat_statements
children.query: CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements;

children.name: pg_catalog
children.query:
select * from (
select 'view' "type", viewname "name" from pg_views where schemaname='pg_catalog'
union all 
select 'table', tablename from pg_tables where schemaname='pg_catalog') a
order by type, name;

children.name: Status
children.query:
SELECT
    pid,
    application_name,
    client_addr,
    state,
    sync_state,
    sent_lsn,
    write_lsn,
    flush_lsn,
    replay_lsn
FROM pg_stat_replication;
